# CANDIDATE: ATR_CONTRACTION_BOS_BREAK_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-07-22
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** new_trigger
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

ATR contraction indicates declining volatility and often precedes explosive breakouts. When a break of structure (BOS) occurs to the upside following ATR contraction, it signals the start of a short-term bullish move that can be captured with a long 0DTE call position. This edge exists because low volatility periods lead to inefficient pricing, and structure breaks often trigger momentum cascades.

## Mechanism

**Entry:** On 5-minute bars, trigger when (1) 14-period ATR < prior bar's ATR (contraction), and (2) current bar's high > highest high of prior 10 bars (BOS upside). Enter long at close of trigger bar.  
**Exit:** Primary stop = low of trigger bar (chart stop). Profit target = 2x risk (entry - stop) OR chandelier trail (20% of high-water mark) after +50% profit. Time exit at 15:50 ET. Position size: ITM-2 calls per account tier (Safe: 3 contracts min).
